title: CPF Module Schema: CosmosDB SQL Container module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cosmosdbsqlcontainer'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

account_name.description: (Required) The name of the Cosmos DB Account to create the container within. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

autoscale_settings.description: (Optional) object({ max_throughput = (Optional) The maximum throughput of the SQL container (RU/s). Must be between 1,000 and 1,000,000. Must be set in increments of 1,000. Conflicts with throughput. })

combined_attributes.type: object({ partition_key_version = optional(number, 1) throughput = optional(number) default_ttl = optional(number, -1) analytical_storage_ttl = optional(number, null) })
combined_attributes.description: (optional) object({ partition_key_version = (Optional) Define a partition key version. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Possible values are 1and 2. This should be set to 2 in order to use large partition keys. throughput = (Optional) The throughput of SQL container (RU/s). Must be set in increments of 100. The minimum value is 400. This must be set upon container creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply. default_ttl = (Optional) The default time to live of SQL container. If missing, items are not expired automatically. If present and the value is set to -1, it is equal to infinity, and items don’t expire by default. If present and the value is set to some number n – items will expire n seconds after their last modified time. analytical_storage_ttl = (Optional) The default time to live of Analytical Storage for this SQL container. If present and the value is set to -1, it is equal to infinity, and items don’t expire by default. If present and the value is set to some number n – items will expire n seconds after their last modified time. })

conflict_resolution_policy.type: map(object({ mode = string conflict_resolution_path = optional(string) conflict_resolution_procedure = optional(string) }))
conflict_resolution_policy.description: (Optional) mode = (Required) Indicates the conflict resolution mode. Possible values include: LastWriterWins, Custom. conflict_resolution_path = (Optional) The conflict resolution path in the case of LastWriterWins mode. conflict_resolution_procedure = (Optional) The procedure to resolve conflicts in the case of Custom mode.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

database_name.description: (Required) The name of the Cosmos DB SQL Database to create the container within. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

indexing_policy.type: object({ indexing_mode = optional(string, "consistent") included_path = optional(map(object({ path = string }))) excluded_path = optional(map(object({ path = string }))) composite_index = optional(map(object({ index = map(object({ path = string order = string })) }))) spatial_index = optional(map(object({ path = string }))) })
indexing_policy.description: (Optional) object({ indexing_mode = (Optional) Indicates the indexing mode. Possible values include: consistent and none. Defaults to consistent. included_path = (Optional) One or more included_path blocks as defined below. Either included_path or excluded_path must contain the path /* map(object({ path = (Required) Path for which the indexing behaviour applies to. })) excluded_path = (Optional) One or more excluded_path blocks as defined below. Either included_path or excluded_path must contain the path /* map(object({ path = (Required) Path that is excluded from indexing. })) composite_index = (Optional) One or more composite_index blocks as defined below. map(object({ index = (Required) One or more index blocks as defined below. map(object({ path = (Required) Path for which the indexing behaviour applies to. order = (Required) Order of the index. Possible values are Ascending or Descending. })) })) spatial_index = (Optional) One or more spatial_index blocks as defined below. map(object({ path = (Required) Path for which the indexing behaviour applies to. According to the service design, all spatial types including LineString, MultiPolygon, Point, and Polygon will be applied to the path. })) })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

name.description: (Optional) Specifies the name of the Cosmos DB SQL Container resource. If not provided, the resource name is created leveraging LSEG variables as per standard naming convention. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

partition_key_kind.description: (Optional) Define a partition key kind. Possible values are Hash and MultiHash. Defaults to Hash. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

partition_key_path.description: (Required) Define a partition key. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sql_function.description: (Optional) map(object({ name = "(Required) The name which should be used for this SQL User Defined Function. Changing this forces a new SQL User Defined Function to be created." body = "(Required) Body of the User Defined Function." }))

sql_storedprocedure.type: map(object({ name = string body = string account_name = string database_name = string }))
sql_storedprocedure.description: (Optional) map(object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Cosmos DB SQL Stored Procedure. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." body = "(Required) The body of the stored procedure." account_name = "(Required) The name of the cosmosdb account." database_name = "(Required) The name of the cosmosdb sql database." }))

sql_trigger.type: map(object({ name = string body = string operation = string type = string }))
sql_trigger.description: (Optional) map(object({ name = "(Required) The name which should be used for this SQL Trigger. Changing this forces a new SQL Trigger to be created." body = "(Required) Body of the SQL Trigger." operation = "(Required) The operation the trigger is associated with. Possible values are All, Create, Update, Delete and Replace." type = "(Required) Type of the Trigger. Possible values are Pre and Post." }))

unique_key.description: (Optional) map(object({ paths = (Required) A list of paths to use for this unique key. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. }))

function_id.description: The ID of the SQL User Defined Function.

function_name.description: The name of the SQL User Defined Function.

id.description: The ID of the CosmosDB SQL Container.

name.description: The name of the CosmosDB SQL Container.

stored_procedure_id.description: The ID of the Cosmos DB SQL Stored Procedure.

stored_procedure_name.description: The name of the Cosmos DB SQL Stored Procedure.

stored_procedure_resource.description: The CosmosDB SQL Stored Procedure resource.

trigger_id.description: The ID of the SQL Trigger.

trigger_name.description: The name of the SQL Trigger.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cosmosdbsqlcontainer' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
